skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Stage 1 — Intake', upload checklist marks 'Reserve account detail' as 'Required for the roll-forward', and references/mosofin-protocol.md 'After an upload, validate the input before any work' says 'If a required input is rejected or missing, stop and ask'. For a new plan with no reserve yet there is nothing to upload; the skill does not say that a nil reserve (no account in the TB) satisfies the requirement, so a strict reading stops the run.

references/edge-cases.md 'Communication after the period end' covers a plan 'approved before the year end and communicated after it' only; it does not cover the case where approval itself is after the period end, nor say what the roll-forward and entries should look like for a period with nothing to recognise.

references/method.md 'Step 1 — A flag on facility exit costs and leases' makes the ROU check '[auto] ... One read of the chart' only; it gives no upload-path instruction (read the TB for an ROU asset) and no instruction for when the TB shows rent but no ROU asset (short-term lease, private-company election, or a missing ASC 842 adoption).

references/output.md 'Coverage and Provenance sheet (mandatory)' Sections A-B are written for the Mosofin path (display_name, get_datasource_tools, effective_policy, mock); the manual-run substitution lives only in mosofin-protocol.md, so the two have to be merged by hand.
sample_defects: manifest.json inputs call restructuring_plan.md the 'Approved restructuring plan', but it is a one-page summary standing in for three separate Required uploads in SKILL.md (the approved plan as PDF, cost by group as XLSX, contracts with penalties); validation must accept it only with a limit.
